`odir`/`cdir` the same three-token enum; the only difference within each pair
is `row`. So the emitted `Or/Attributes.elm` carries both shapes side by side
and the golden pins the difference to exactly the row string — an open entry
that silently changed its argument type, body, or doc would diff too.
`class` is here as the untouched bare-string baseline: the four-item
`defaultGlobals` roster stays closed, and this suite would catch a change that
An `_globals` entry with no `row` key MUST mean exactly what it meant before
the key existed, which is what `cflag`/`cdir`/`class` assert.
